title_sq: Tek "Ekspozita Building, Shitet Apartament 1+1 Me Pamje Spektakolare
description_sq: Tek Ndertesa Multifunksionale "Ekspozita Building" Shitet Apartament 1+1 Me Pamje Spektakolare!!! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 13 te nje ndertimi 24 katesh. Ndertesa Multifunksionale "Ekspozita Building" ka nje pozicion stratgjik buze Bulevardit Gjergj Fishta dhe karakterizohet nga cilesi e larte e ndertimit dhe arkitektura unike. Ndertim premium per qytetin e Tiranes eshte i nderthurur me njesi sherbimesh komerciale, ambiente per zyra si dhe apartamente. Apartamenti ka siperfaqe totale: 88.61m2 prej te cilave: 66.63 m2 jane siperfaqe e brendshme. Apartamenti organizohet ne koridorin hyres i cili ben shperndarjen e ambienteve, salloni i ndenies bashke me kendin e gatimit te vecuar, dhoma e gjumit si dhe nje tualet. Orientimi i apartamentit eshte nga Veri-Lindja si dhe kati i larte i mundesojne pamje spektakolaredhe ndricim natyral gjate gjithe dites.
title_en: At "Expozita Building, 1+1 Apartment For Sale With Spectacular View
description_en: 1+1 Apartment with Spectacular View for Sale in the "Exposita Building" Multifunctional Building!!! The apartment is located on the 13th floor of a 24-story building. The Multifunctional Building "Exhibition Building" has a strategic position on the edge of Gjergj Fishta Boulevard and is characterized by high quality construction and unique architecture. Premium building for the city of Tirana is interspersed with commercial service units, office premises and apartments. The apartment has a total surface: 88.61 m2, of which: 66.63 m2 are internal surface. The apartment is organized in the entrance corridor, which distributes the premises, the living room together with the separate cooking corner, the bedroom and a toilet. The orientation of the apartment is from the North-East, and the upper floor allows for spectacular views and natural lighting throughout the day.
